title: Rifabutin as a US overlay rifamycin
dek: Rifabutin is not WHO’s default DS-TB rifamycin. CDC-land uses it when rifampin’s CYP induction wrecks a PI-based or other brittle ART/immunosuppression regimen. Cross-R with rpoB is expected, not guaranteed identical.
story: Rifampin induces CYP3A4/UGT hard. Protease inhibitors, some immunosuppressants, and a long tail of other drugs collapse. Rifabutin induces less and is a CDC-familiar substitute in DS-TB when the companion regimen cannot be rebuilt around twice-daily dolutegravir or a rifampin-safe backbone.

WHO programmes rarely stock rifabutin as first-line TB therapy. Do not write RFB into a 2HRZE/4HR NTP recipe because a US fellow mentioned it. The molecule is still a rifamycin: rpoB RRDR resistance usually takes it down with rifampin, but some disputed alleles and MIC splits exist — treat RFB DST as its own row when it matters.
Rifapentine is the other rifamycin on WHO paper (TPT, HPMZ). It is not a gentler-inducer substitute in the rifabutin sense. Three names, three jobs.
deep: Rifabutin uveitis is real, especially with clarithromycin or high AUC. The NTM clinic knows this; the TB clinic should too.
Dose adjustments with boosted PIs are a CDC table, not a memory item from Wikipedia.
Xpert RIF-R means do not use rifabutin as the “mild RR” rifamycin.

visual.caption: Three rifamycins, three jobs. Induction strength is schematic, not a PK paper. RRDR resistance is the shared cliff.

example.title: PI-based ART and new DS-TB
example.setup: US clinic, boosted PI, new pan-S pulmonary TB. Team wants to keep the PI.

steps.title: First choice is still rebuild ART
steps.body: DTG BID with rifampin is the WHO-shaped move when possible.

steps.title: If the PI is immovable, RFB is the overlay
steps.body: CDC tables, not NTP HRZE with a mystery swap.

steps.title: If rpoB is mutant, stop
steps.body: Rifabutin is not salvage RR therapy.

example.takeaway: Rifabutin is a CYP-polite rifamycin for a US interaction problem, not a fourth first-line letter.

check.prompt: In WHO DS-TB programmes, rifabutin is:

check.answer: Not the default rifamycin; a CDC-style substitute when induction is intolerable
check.why: WHO’s R is rifampin. RFB is overlay chemistry.
